svg.title: Awards and notifications
svg.desc: Each chart compares mean individual one-off awards with notifications grouped by the action that earned them, in 30-minute blocks. A target of two to four per block applies only to the first two hours. Means can conceal uneven blocks, so the chart reports the percentage of blocks within target. Event bonuses are off. Delivery saver 43.8% of early blocks have 2–4 awards; 89.1% have 2–4 notifications; First cab 38.9% of early blocks have 2–4 awards; 77.9% have 2–4 notifications; Fleet reinvestor 21.8% of early blocks have 2–4 awards; 63% have 2–4 notifications; Customizer 19.7% of early blocks have 2–4 awards; 66.9% have 2–4 notifications; Delivery explorer 23.8% of early blocks have 2–4 awards; 67% have 2–4 notifications; 30-minute casual 42.3% of early blocks have 2–4 awards; 59.6% have 2–4 notifications; Mixed economy 28.7% of early blocks have 2–4 awards; 48.3% have 2–4 notifications.

g.text: Mean per 30m · blue awards, gold alerts
A notification groups awards from one action.
Means can hide dry spells · events off.
